issues: The script is a template and will fail if run directly. The path to the executable is defined using a CMake placeholder (`exe="@CMAKE_BINARY_DIR@/..."`). This `@CMAKE_BINARY_DIR@` token must be replaced by a build system with the actual path to the executable before the script can be run.

The job requests only a single CPU core (`--cpus-per-task=1`) to accompany a GPU. This can create a significant performance bottleneck, as the single CPU may struggle with data loading, pre-processing, and kernel launching, leading to underutilization of the GPU. It is generally recommended to request more CPUs for a GPU workload.
